title: CIC Decimator
text: Decimate signal using CIC filter, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Output data type} sets Data type of output Full; {Decimation factor source} sets the source of decimation, {Decimation factor (R)}, {Decimation factor (Rmax)} sets the upper bound of variable decimation factor, {Differential delay (M)}, {Number of sections (N)} sets the number of integrator and comb sections, {Gain correction} sets the output gain compensation, {Output word length} sets the word length of output, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal and {Use HDL global reset} sets the option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: CIC-decimated output data scalar | column vector

params.name: Decimation factor source
params.values: Source of decimation factor Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Decimation factor (Rmax)
params.values: Upper bound of variable decimation factor 2 (default) | integer from 1 to 2048

params.name: Number of sections (N)
params.values: Number of integrator and comb sections 2 (default) | 1 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Full precision (default) | Same word length as input | Minimum section word lengths

params.name: Output word length
params.values: Word length of output 16 (default) | integer from 2 to 104

params.name: Use HDL global reset
params.values: Option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset signal off (default) | on
